neuthos.outputs module#

class neuthos.outputs.Outputs(base_dir=PosixPath('.'))[source]#

Bases: object

Handles output and visualization functionalities for neutronics calculations.

This class provides methods to write various data outputs to CSV files and create visualizations for source definitions. It supports both 2D and 3D visualizations and manages output routing through a configurable base directory.

Parameters:

base_dir (Path) – Base directory for routing all output files. Defaults to current directory.

base_dir: Path = PosixPath('.')#
visualize_source_ass(geom, source, flag)[source]#

Visualize assembly source definition. The visualization can be either 2D (at core midplane) or 3D based on the flag provided.

Parameters:

  • geom (Geometry)

  • source (Source)

  • flag (str)

Return type:

Path

visualize_source_pin(geom, source, flag)[source]#

Visualize pin source definition. The visualization can be either 2D (at core midplane) or 3D based on the flag provided. If 3D is selected, a .csv file readable by Paraview Table to Points option is created. Use Paraview to visualize the source for 3D definition.

Parameters:

  • geom (Geometry)

  • source (Source)

  • flag (str)

Return type:

Path

write_PARCS_pin_coordinates(geom, outputpath)[source]#

Write PARCS pin-level coordinates from a Geometry instance to a CSV file.

The output file is created at the given path (relative to the output base directory, if configured) and contains one row per pin with indices and Cartesian coordinates.

Parameters:

  • geom (Geometry)

  • outputpath (str | Path)

Return type:

Path

write_VERA_pin_coordinates(geom, outputpath)[source]#

Write VERA pin-level coordinates with VERA indices from a Geometry instance to a CSV file.

The output file is created at the given path (relative to the output base directory, if configured) and contains one row per pin with indices, VERA index, and Cartesian coordinates.

Parameters:

  • geom (Geometry)

  • outputpath (str | Path)

Return type:

Path
